title: Blob Storage Access Tiers and Lifecycle
description: Understand hot, cool, cold, and archive access tiers, and how lifecycle management policies automatically move blobs between tiers.

data.text: Azure Blob Storage access tiers let you match storage cost to how often you access your data. Hot tier is cheapest for frequent access, while archive is cheapest for long-term, rarely-accessed data. **Lifecycle management** policies can automatically move blobs between tiers based on age or other rules.

Lifecycle management is a set of rules stored as JSON. Each rule has filters (prefix, blob type) and actions (move to tier, delete, or snapshot). Azure evaluates the rules daily and applies them automatically.

data.title: Lifecycle Management Rule JSON
data.content: Move logs to cool after 30 days and archive after 90 days

data.title: Set Blob Tier with Azure CLI
data.content: Move a blob to the archive tier
data.code:
az storage blob set-tier \
  --account-name stdemostorage \
  --container-name backups \
  --name old-backup.zip \
  --tier Archive \
  --auth-mode login

terms.definition: A pricing layer that balances storage and access costs based on how often data is used.
Automated policies that move or delete blobs based on age, prefix, or other rules.
The process of copying an archived blob back to an online tier (hot, cool, or cold) so it can be read.

data.title: Rehydration Takes Time
data.text: Rehydrating from archive tier can take hours. Do not archive data you might need on short notice. For data that must remain available within minutes, use cool or cold tiers instead.

data.title: Exercise: Configure Lifecycle Rules
data.description: Create a lifecycle policy in the Azure Portal and verify it is applied.
steps: In your storage account, go to Data management > Lifecycle management.
Add a rule named 'archive-logs' for blobs in the 'logs/' prefix.
Set actions to move to cool after 30 days and archive after 90 days.
Save the rule and observe the management view.
data.expectedOutcome: A lifecycle rule saved in the portal that will automatically move matching blobs.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Hot tier is for frequently accessed data; archive is for rarely accessed data.
Lifecycle rules can automatically move blobs between tiers.
Rehydrating from archive takes hours and costs more than online tiers.
Choose tiers based on access patterns, not just storage cost.
data.takeaway: Access tiers and lifecycle management let you control storage cost without manual work.
